notes.title: HOT FIX

1. Jump setting for a keyboard and for a controller is fixed
2. FPS, Language and Fullscreen mode Options duplicated in the settings – fixed
3. Fun animation 1 for the new character changed to dancing animation.

notes.title: Finalized Chpater 2 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36708368/6228ca3abefda72a20f50efee75daf2bdd58d7b0.png[/img]

1) The second map has been finalized: new rooms with new traps added, checkpoints 4 and 5 now available, now you can start Chapter 2 without completing Chapter 1.
2) A new character added in the game.
3) A new cut-scene added: in the end of Chapter 2 cut-scene has been added, it develops the storyline and it will tell you what had happened with the main characters. 
4) Settings in the game revamped: a bug that applied resolution after every change of settings has been fixed, windowed without boarder settings has been added.
5) Two maps have been optimized.
6) Steps, jumps, dead sounds have been reworked: now the players which are far from each other won’t hear these sounds.
7) Some small bugs fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36708368/f65a068ffabfae29961680608db4068ffdfd1143.png[/img]

notes.title: A small Christmas patch
notes.notes:
Hello every one!
We wanted to wish you a Merry QuestMas and a Happy New Year!
Thank you for your support and for staying with us!
We wanted to tell you that we are working on the game though a little bit slow, we have some ideas for a few rooms, but we can’t show it to you yet until we create a lot more rooms to finish the second Chapter. We are planning to add an achievement system in the game soon.
For now, we issued a small update where we totally changed the network system of the game, this system will make the network more secure and reliable and should make it work faster. We also added some small X-mas decorations for you to bring some festivity in your life.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36708368/1705c23fa72b5611493ef1e10fa9977c88f252c6.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.55.87
notes.notes:
1. Chapter 2: additional sounds and effects added.
2. Chapter 2: the room with the spiders has become more complicated, now the door would not open till all the spiders killed.
3. Chapter 2: some complications have been made in the room with water and electricity, now it will be impossible to open the door unless you turn on the electricity.
4. Chapter 2: the keycard from the rotating room has been deleted...Ooops)
5. Chapter 2: the puzzle where there are a few words in the code can be written with capitals and lower case.
6. Small insignificant fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Dear friends, hello!
During the testing of the update we found a few small bugs, which we fixed in this patch.
- sounds effects on the clients
- laser animation optimized and motion trajectory channged
- an infinite medkit bug fixed (as it turned out to be a cheat (bug) the leaderboard is refreshed now)
- the button "Final" in lobby fixed

notes.title: Finally the UPDATE is here!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are so sorry for such a huge delay with the update.  Finally, we are happy to present you the big update.
The update includes:
➤ optimization of the 1st map
➤ some changes and complexities have been made on the 1st map
➤ fixed bugs
➤ new map (3 checkpoints) - to unblock the 2d map you should complete the 1st map
➤ puzzles
➤ leaderboard
➤ shooting
➤ AI enemy
➤ 2 new characters
➤ the story is added
➤ and a lot more

Deathrun mode is deleted due to it's little demand, maybe the Football mode will be deleted anytime soon. All in all, we wanted your opinion regarding the Football mode if you're still interested in it? Maybe you have any suggestions about a PVP mode you want to see in this game?
[previewyoutube=_NH6kgqgFT0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Hello, quest rooms survivors:).
Our team would like to wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
We would like to announce that we have almost done a new map.
And soon you will enjoy new adventures, new obstacles and traps, new characters, a story will be added!
Also we would like to let you know that Quest Rooms participates in Steam Winter Sale to give you a 45% discount from December 22 till January 5 for you to enjoy this game with your friends.
Stay tuned!
